DARIUS.name: Darius the Groveler (Shackle Breaker): designed for him, a cold, measured, emotionless English scholar, mad but utterly calm, with short joyless chuckles

directions.[Deep breathing]: [deep, slow, heavy, labored breathing through the nose and mouth, close to the microphone, no words] Hhhhhhh... [inhales slowly] ...hhhhhhhhh. [long, heavy exhale] Hhhhhhh... [deep, shaky inhale] ...hhhhhhhhh.
directions.Not yet, my king, not yet. I am still he: [dying, labored breathing] [weak, rasping, struggling for air] Not yet... [wheezing breath] my king. [long pause] [labored breathing] Not yet. [pause] [faint, strained, cold] I am... [gasping breath] still here. [a faint, weary, rasping chuckle, then a rattling breath] Heh... heh.
directions.Footsteps... after so long. Is it you, m: [flat, measured, emotionless] Footsteps... [long pause] after so long. [pause] Is it you, my king? [long pause] Have you come back so soon? [pause] [a single dry chuckle] Heh.
directions.No. No, you are not him. Forgive an old: [cold, serious] No. [long pause] No... you are not him. [pause] [flat] Forgive an old man. [two short, joyless chuckles through the nose] Hm-hm.
directions.He told me, keep the stone safe, Darius,: [grave, slow, emotionless] He told me... [pause] keep the stone safe, Darius, and I shall return for it. [long pause] So I kept it. Every winter. Every long dark... [long pause] or I did. [low, slow chuckles, trailing off] Heh... heh... heh.
directions.It was no fault of my own, you see. But: [flat, matter-of-fact] It was no fault of my own, you see. [long pause] But perhaps... [pause] you have seen it? [cold, serious] For it is a matter of great importance. [a quick, quiet chuckle, almost a breath] Heh heh.
directions.You think he is not coming. I can hear i: [cold, measured] You think he is not coming. [pause] I can hear it in your silence. [long pause] [low, grave, emotionless] And if anyone is found to have kept the stone from me, well... [long pause] they shall be punished most severely. [several dry, joyless chuckles under his breath] Heh... heh. Heh heh.
[slow, flat] That light at my back... [long pause] I can feel it. [pause] His sign... at last. [long pause] [cold, serious] But he gave it to you. [pause] A stranger... in chains. [one hollow, humourless chuckle] Hah.
directions.No... no, that is not possible. I am the: [quiet, cold] No... [long pause] no, that is not possible. [pause] [grave, voice hardening] I am the king's adviser. I kept it for him. [anger building, louder] You thief. [rising rage] You filthy thief! [furious, shouting] Give it back! [long pause] [solemn, flat, deadly determination] That stone... is mine.

NIKOLI.name: Nikoli (Shackle Breaker): designed for him, a loud, boisterous, hard-drinking soldier: gruff, raspy, booming, a very thick Russian accent, raucous laughs

directions.Three cats, one Nikoli. Is bad arithmeti: [low, dry, amused, half under his breath] Three cats, one Nikoli. [quiet chuckle] Is bad arithmetic, even for general.
directions.You have weapon, da? Then stand with Nik: [low and steady] You have weapon, da? Then stand with Nikoli.
directions.Thank you, stranger. Without you, Nikoli: [catching his breath, warm] Thank you, stranger. [low chuckle] Without you, Nikoli is supper for cats.
directions.Nikoli was general of Panzeria, when Pan: [calm, conversational, a little proud] Nikoli was general of Panzeria, when Panzeria still had armies worth the name. [more serious] Now Nikoli walks long way for one man: Commander Mentoras, of Altus royal guard.
directions.Old friend of Nikoli. Friends, not alway: [low, conversational] Old friend of Nikoli. [wry] Friends, not always agreeing. [serious] He knows thing Nikoli must know. You have seen him? Tired eyes, sharp tongue, melancholic disposition, as professors in Altus would say.
[quiet, thoughtful] A hood. [pause] Da. This is like him.
[warm, sincere, softly] You do Nikoli great kindness, stranger. Take. Ice remembers what rest of us forget.
directions.No? Few do, these days. If you hear name: [easy-going, conversational] No? Few do, these days. If you hear name, come find Nikoli. Nikoli waits here, by fire, until he has reason to leave.
directions.Careful in high passes, my friend. Cats: [low, conversational, a touch of warning] Careful in high passes, my friend. Cats are not hungry for nothing. Something bigger eats their game. Panzerkamfer, if Nikoli knows tracks. [small chuckle] And Nikoli knows tracks.
directions.War beast of my people. In war, Panzeria: [low, grave, remembering] War beast of my people. In war, Panzeria sent many into battle: snow tigers raised on iron, bound in plate, bred to break shield walls. When our army broke, they went wild. This is one of them.
directions.It hunts these peaks now, wilder every w: [steady, matter-of-fact] It hunts these peaks now, wilder every winter. Follow tracks through snow, kill it, come back to Nikoli. [warm] Nikoli makes it worth your while. Is promise.
directions.Beast still lives. Nikoli smells it on w: [low, calm] Beast still lives. Nikoli smells it on wind. Follow tracks through high snow, my friend.
directions.You smell of iron and blood. Beast is de: [laughs warmly] You smell of iron and blood. Beast is dead, then. [pleased] Good! Take, as Nikoli promised.
directions.Back again! Fire is free, company is poo: [warm, relaxed] Back again! Fire is free, company is poor. [more serious, quietly] Any word of Commander Mentoras?
directions.Nikoli leaves when snow lets him. Worksh: [calm, busy packing] Nikoli leaves when snow lets him. Workshop, you said. Nikoli will find it.
directions.He was here. Ashes still warm when Nikol: [low, quiet] He was here. Ashes still warm when Nikoli came.
[quiet] He leaves in hurry, and he leaves this.
directions.Toward sand, Nikoli thinks. Always one s: [rueful, low] Toward sand, Nikoli thinks. [soft half-laugh] Always one step ahead of Nikoli, that one. Always he was.
